newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Fighting cocks die in Colombian farm raid.
newsitem.headline: Fighting cocks die in Colombian farm raid.

text.p: At least 300 fighting cocks were burned alive during a leftist rebel attack on a farm in northern Colombia on Monday, police said.
The highly-prized birds belonged to a prominent singer, Jorge Onate, and police said his henhouse was gutted in the raid, along with four houses, a tractor and a barn.
Police said they believed Onate had refused to pay a "war tax" to leftist rebels operating in Cesar province.
Cockfighting, in which cocks armed with metal spurs battle to the death, is popular in northern and coastal parts of Colombia.
